definitions.gloss: waist cord (used when putting on a kimono)
definitions.explanation: A thin cloth cord tied around the waist, used mainly to hold a kimono in place while dressing, before the {帯|おび} is added.

examples.japanese: {着物|きもの}を{腰紐|こしひも}で{留|と}めた。
examples.english: I secured the kimono with a waist cord.

examples.japanese: {腰紐|こしひも}をきつく{結|むす}びすぎた。
examples.english: I tied the waist cord too tightly.

examples.japanese: {着付|きつ}けでは{何本|なんぼん}もの{腰紐|こしひも}を{使|つか}って{形|かたち}を{整|ととの}える。
examples.english: When dressing in kimono, several waist cords are used to shape the garment.

notes:
A thin cloth cord tied at the waist, used mainly when putting on a kimono to hold the layers in place before the {帯|おび} (sash) is added.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {腰紐|こしひも}を{結|むす}ぶ: to tie a waist cord
- {着付|きつ}けに{腰紐|こしひも}を{使|つか}う: to use waist cords when dressing in kimono

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {帯|おび}: the wide decorative kimono sash worn over everything
- {伊達|だて}{締|じ}め: a wider supporting band used in kimono dressing
